result.analyst_notes: Corporate third-person-plural 'we' voice with absolute, emphatic phrasing ('We demand', 'unwavering commitment'). Mission and vision lead with shareholders and financial soundness before other stakeholders. Values are framed as three alliterated named terms. Investment is reframed around employees and assets. Partners and investors are named as audiences; communities and customers are absent.
